description: Native key-value storage using a Header;Payload micro-serialization protocol.

additionalProperties.description: Must follow [Type(,Param);Payload] with a non-empty Payload. E.g., string;abc, integer;0xFF, float;3.14, boolean;true, base64,0x400;SGVsbG8=. A boolean Payload accepts true/false, yes/no, on/off and 1/0, case-insensitively (PHP FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN compatible); boolean; with an empty Payload is not allowed.
